position.en: M.S. Candidate · Department of Automation, Tsinghua University

headline.zh: 人工智能、信号处理与嵌入式系统
headline.en: AI, signal processing, and embedded systems.

intro.zh: 我在清华大学自动化系攻读硕士学位，关注人工智能、信号处理、应用数学与嵌入式系统的交叉问题。研究将结构化建模与数据驱动方法结合，并在工业感知、实时处理和复杂工程系统中验证。
intro.en: I am a master’s student in Automation at Tsinghua University. My interests span AI, signal processing, applied mathematics, and embedded systems. I combine structured modeling with data-driven methods and test them in industrial sensing, real-time processing, and complex engineering systems.

title.zh: 人工智能
title.en: Artificial intelligence

description.zh: 结合领域知识与机器学习，研究稳健识别、可解释推断和生成式分析。
description.en: Combining domain knowledge and machine learning for robust recognition, interpretable inference, and generative analysis.

title.zh: 信号处理
title.en: Signal processing

description.zh: 面向含噪、多峰和动态数据，设计自适应滤波、特征提取及质量评估方法。
description.en: Designing adaptive filtering, feature extraction, and quality assessment for noisy, multimodal, and dynamic data.

title.zh: 应用数学
title.en: Applied mathematics

description.zh: 利用优化、统计推断与结构稳定性分析，将工程问题转化为可验证的数学模型。
description.en: Using optimization, statistical inference, and structural stability to turn engineering questions into testable models.

title.zh: 嵌入式系统
title.en: Embedded systems

description.zh: 关注算法在实时计算、嵌入式系统和复杂工程中的实现与部署。
description.en: Implementing and deploying algorithms under real-time, embedded systems, and complex engineering scenarios.

publications.title: Neighborhood Width Transform: A Structural Stability Framework for Peak Selection in Noisy 1D Coherence Curves

summary.zh: 提出邻域宽度变换，将含噪一维相干曲线的谱峰选择建模为结构稳定性问题。
summary.en: Introduces the Neighborhood Width Transform to select peaks in noisy one-dimensional coherence curves through structural stability.

publications.citation: S. Li and Z. Ye, “Neighborhood Width Transform: A Structural Stability Framework for Peak Selection in Noisy 1D Coherence Curves,” Mathematics, vol. 14, no. 12, art. no. 2156, 2026, doi: 10.3390/math14122156.

publications.title: Online-Adaptive Filtering in STC Processing For Real-Time Logging While Drilling System

summary.zh: 设计在线自适应滤波方法，并针对嵌入式系统的实时计算需求进行实现。阵列声波处理是方法的验证场景。
summary.en: Develops online-adaptive filtering for real-time embedded computation, evaluated in array acoustic processing.

publications.citation: S. Li and Z. Ye, “Online-Adaptive Filtering in STC Processing For Real-Time Logging While Drilling System,” in IEEE Embedded Systems Letters, doi: 10.1109/LES.2026.3730142.

publications.title: Knowledge-Informed Neural Network for Peak Identification and Slowness Extraction in Array Acoustic Logging
publications.authors: Sicheng Li, Limeng Tian, Zhaohui Ye
publications.venue: 2026 7th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning (PRML), Urumqi, China, pp. 140–145, 2026

summary.zh: 将先验知识融入神经网络，用阵列声波数据验证含噪峰值识别与参数提取。
summary.en: Integrates prior knowledge into a neural network and evaluates noisy peak identification and parameter extraction on array acoustic data.

publications.citation: S. Li, L. Tian and Z. Ye, “Knowledge-Informed Neural Network for Peak Identification and Slowness Extraction in Array Acoustic Logging,” 2026 7th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning (PRML), Urumqi, China, 2026, pp. 140–145, doi: 10.1109/PRML71097.2026.11687294.

title.zh: 阵列声波的时差确定方法、装置、设备及存储介质
title.en: Method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for determining time differences in array acoustic signals

status.zh: 中国发明专利 · 2026 年 1 月授权

period.en: July 2026 · China Academy of Space Technology internship

title.zh: 卫星故障根因分析研究
title.en: Satellite fault root-cause analysis research

description.zh: 围绕空间复杂约束下的故障解释，调研遥测异常、系统知识与故障先验的结合方式，设计结构化分析方案和专业版、用户版报告界面，并完成专题研究报告与汇报。
description.en: Investigated fault explanations under complex space-system constraints, connecting telemetry anomalies with system knowledge and fault priors. Designed a structured analysis approach and expert/user-facing report concepts, and delivered a research report.

period.zh: 研究实践 · 清华大学

title.zh: 含噪曲线谱峰识别的结构稳定性方法
title.en: Structural stability for peak selection in noisy curves

description.zh: 提出邻域宽度变换，将一维相干曲线中的谱峰选择转化为结构稳定性分析问题，研究噪声和局部伪峰下的可靠识别。成果发表于SCI一区期刊《Mathematics》。
description.en: Developed the Neighborhood Width Transform to formulate peak selection in one-dimensional coherence curves as a structural stability problem, studying robust identification under noise and spurious local peaks. Published SCI JCR Q1 journal

period.zh: 研究实践 · 清华大学

title.zh: 知识引导的神经网络与模式识别
title.en: Knowledge-informed neural networks and pattern recognition

description.zh: 研究结合领域先验与轻量学习模型的谱峰识别方法，应对噪声干扰、局部伪峰及波型重叠，相关工作发表在 PRML 2026 会议上。
description.en: Studied how domain priors and lightweight learning models can identify characteristic peaks under noise, spurious extrema, and overlapping modes. Related work formed a PRML 2026 conference paper.

period.zh: 硕士课题 · 清华大学 / 中海油服合作项目
period.en: Master's  Dissertation · Tsinghua University / COSL collaboration

title.zh: 实时信号处理与嵌入式算法
title.en: Real-time signal processing and embedded algorithms

description.zh: 在工业阵列传感场景中，使用 C++ 实现预处理、谱峰搜索、参数估计、连续性约束与质量控制，构建可集成的实时处理流程。
description.en: Built a C++ pipeline for industrial array sensing, combining preprocessing, peak search, parameter estimation, continuity constraints, and quality control.

period.zh: 研究实践 · 哈尔滨工业大学

title.zh: 基于 Kinect 的智能移动机器人
title.en: Kinect-based intelligent mobile robot

description.zh: 将手势识别、指令解析与移动控制整合到机器人系统，完成视觉感知到动作执行的闭环。
description.en: Integrated gesture recognition, command interpretation, and mobile control into a visual perception-to-action robotic system.
